climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A PDO in the Pannon region, known for full-bodied, Bordeaux-style red wines. Cabernet Sauvignon is the most planted grape at 18%, followed by Blauer Portugieser at 15%, Cabernet Franc at 13% and Merlot at 12%.
